description.value: Alberni Co-op is a member-owned co-operative grocery and retail operation serving Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, affiliated with the Western Canada Co-operative Retailing System. As a true local co-op, it is governed by community members and tailored to local needs, and also operates a liquor store and gas bar/convenience component. For a touring cyclist rolling into Port Alberni, it represents a full-service community grocery stop with the breadth typical of Western Canadian Co-op associations.
